overrideReason: All blocking issues are pre-existing and unrelated to the service generator feature. See AGENTS.md 'Known Pre-Existing Issues'. The service generator itself passed code review with 34 tests passing. TypeScript errors (70+), app test failures (62), backend test failures (3), and missing lint config all existed before this mission.

typecheck.note: TypeScript compilation failed with numerous errors across app and backend packages

lint.note: No lint script found at root level; lint not configured in services.yaml

blockingIssues.description: TypeScript typecheck fails across packages/app and packages/backend with numerous errors. The app package has 40+ type errors in components (distribucion, sales, purchases, sync, reports), hooks (use-invitation-public), and lib files. The backend package has 30+ type errors including missing exports (DbTransaction), missing modules (repository imports), and type incompatibility issues (SyncRequestContext vs RequestContext, syncStatus type mismatches). These errors are pre-existing and not directly caused by the service generator, but they prevent the milestone from being considered stable.

App tests fail with 62 failures out of 300 tests. Failures are concentrated in: (1) device-fingerprint tests (3 failures) due to 'server' environment detection returning static values instead of UUIDs, (2) staged-pull-coordinator tests (28 failures) due to missing 'createSyncStageMachine' export in @avileo/shared mock. These failures appear to be pre-existing and unrelated to the service generator feature.

Backend tests fail with 3 failures in sale-sync.race.test.ts due to ECONNREFUSED to PostgreSQL on port 5432. The test requires a running database but none is available during test execution. This is an infrastructure/test setup issue, not a code issue.

No lint script is configured. The services.yaml defines 'lint: turbo run lint' but the root package.json does not have a 'lint' script, and individual packages do not appear to have lint scripts configured.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the pattern that BaseService.now() returns a string (toLocalISOString) and manual/generated services must wrap it in new Date() when assigning to Date-typed Drizzle columns.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: create-service-generator review: Generated services follow tag-service.ts pattern of wrapping now in new Date(). AGENTS.md documents now() but not the new Date() wrapping.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add proper lint scripts to packages or update services.yaml to reference existing lint commands. Currently 'turbo run lint' fails because no package has a lint script.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Validator execution: bun run lint failed with 'Script not found lint'. Root package.json has no lint script.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that Drizzle decimal columns map to 'string' TypeScript type (not number) to help future generator work and prevent type confusion.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: create-service-generator review: Test at line 201 expects 'price: string' for decimal column. This is Drizzle ORM behavior.

rejectedObservations.observation: Generated services use 'typeof tags.$inferSelect' for return types rather than explicit imported types like 'Tag'.
rejectedObservations.reason: Both patterns work. The generated code's approach is self-contained and avoids needing the shared package to export named types for every table. This is a valid design choice, not an issue.
